description: The line plot illustrates the relative change in precision for different configurations of a KV cache compression algorithm across various layers of a neural network. The x-axis represents the layers of the network, labeled as "Layer1-4," "Layer5-12," "Layer13-20," "Layer21-28," and "Layer29-32." The y-axis measures the relative change in precision, ranging from -25% to 5%, with a baseline of 4×tokens, 4-bit indicated by a dashed line. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different configuration: "LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit" (yellow line with circle markers), "LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit" (red line with square markers), "RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit" (blue line with circle markers), "RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit" (dark blue line with square markers), and a baseline (dashed gray line). The lines show varying degrees of change in precision across the layers, with some configurations experiencing increases in precision, while others show decreases. The plot does not include any inferred data points or conclusions about the cause of these changes.
